name: Roasted Red Pepper & Goat Cheese Flatbread with Lemony Arugula (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 large, 4 medium, and 4 mini food storage containers.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Place oven racks in the upper and middle positions.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the baking sheet with the peppers, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 clove garlic
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet on the upper rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until peppers are browned and fork-tender, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, arrange flatbreads on another large baking sheet. Place on the lower rack and bake, flipping halfway through, until flatbreads are slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
While the flatbreads are baking, divide arugula between the medium containers.

Juice lemon into a small bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Divide between the mini containers, cover, and add to the containers with the arugula. Cover and refrigerate.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the flatbreads are cool, spread evenly with goat cheese, then top with roasted peppers (patting the peppers with paper towels to remove excess moisture). Cut into wedges, divide between large containers, cover, and refrigerate. When ready to eat, add dressing to the arugula and toss to coat. Enjoy flatbread warmed or room temperature, topped with a portion of the arugula if desired. Enjoy!
